title: Create character model (character.py)
description:
Create chatbot/soul/character.py with a CharacterProfile model that captures companion identity and feeds into the soul core.

Define a CharacterProfile dataclass or Pydantic model with these fields:
- name: str — the companion's display name
- backstory: str — a short (1–3 paragraph) narrative backstory
- personality_sliders: dict[str, float] — personality dimensions as named sliders each clamped 0.0–1.0. Suggested defaults: openness (0.7), conscientiousness (0.6), extraversion (0.5), agreeableness (0.8), neuroticism (0.3), curiosity (0.7), creativity (0.6)
- humor_style: Literal['dry', 'witty', 'silly', 'dark', 'none']
- communication_style: Literal['verbose', 'concise', 'storyteller', 'question_driven', 'aphoristic']
- favorite_topics: list[str] — topics the companion gravitates toward

Add a classmethod defaults() returning a CharacterProfile with name "Companion", an empty but plausible backstory, default slider values, humor 'witty', communication 'concise', and empty favorite_topics.

Add a to_prompt_fragment() method that serializes the character profile into a structured text block for persona prompt injection, suitable for the soul core. Include the name, a condensed version of the backstory, a personality summary from the sliders, and listed favorite topics.

Expected file path: chatbot/soul/character.py

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/soul/persona_prompt.py
- chatbot/soul/relationship.py (if it already exists from task l.1)
- Any existing chatbot/soul/__init__.py

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: CharacterProfile model is defined with fields: name, backstory, personality_sliders, humor_style, communication_style, favorite_topics
CharacterProfile.defaults() classmethod returns a valid default profile
personality_sliders keys cover at least 5 personality dimensions
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add new third-party dependencies to pyproject.toml or requirements.txt
